stateOwner: the Qt controller owns one Qt-native child window, surface epoch, latest positive physical size, latest committed project preview schedule, playback generation, current frame and inclusive timeline frame range, one in-flight command, one pending resize, one pending tick, one latest seek intent, pause and resume intent, cancellation admission, UI receipt state, and the shutdown barrier
threadContract: the Qt UI thread owns only QWindow embedding, immutable project source publication, bounded transport intent, and completion-triggered single-shot tick admission; one persistent background presentation thread constructs, resizes, plays, seeks, ticks, pauses, resumes, cancels, closes, and destroys PreviewPresentationSession

invariants.nativeOwnership: QML embeds one Qt-owned QWindow through WindowContainer; no external-window wrapper or manual child HWND is introduced
invariants.physicalSize: the UI thread reads the embedded HWND client rectangle and never submits zero width or height to the preview session
invariants.backgroundOwnership: session construction, resize, close, and destruction occur on the same persistent background presentation thread
invariants.boundedQueue: only one synchronous session command is in flight, resize bursts retain only the latest distinct physical size, seek bursts retain only the latest exact target, and a tick completion admits at most one later single-shot tick
invariants.cancellation: project replacement and shutdown request the admitted stop source; replacement clears the old playback before starting the latest source, and shutdown admits no later resize, play, or tick
invariants.projectCommit: only a latest successful project load publishes its immutable bounded stable-ID project-compiled preview schedule after every scheduled media source resolves; failed, partial, and cancelled loads preserve the committed preview
invariants.playbackEvidence: the controller retains the latest accepted play or tick receipt by value so tests can distinguish project-driven render, present, and EOF proof from a typed audio-device-unavailable partial result
invariants.replacement: project generation, source serial, surface epoch, and playback generation reject stale completions; an offline, unsupported, or empty replacement clears the previous surface
invariants.surfaceEpoch: a changed HWND retires the current session instead of reusing its swap chain or accepting stale completion
invariants.transport: Pause interrupts one admitted tick, then serializes same-generation pause before admitting more cadence; Resume preserves the source serial and generation and restarts completion-triggered ticks; an adjacent clip boundary atomically replaces input, compiled layer, audio, and generation before cadence continues; direct seek can replace the active scheduled clip while preserving playing or paused intent, while direct seek and one-frame steps refuse gap or out-of-range targets without clamping and one-frame steps always replace playback into paused state
invariants.shutdown: the root QML window waits for both project loading and preview session close before allowing Qt to destroy the child window; one guarded drain handles explicit quit before exit, aboutToQuit fallback, and post-event-loop fallback, close failure changes a successful exit code, and unexpected controller teardown retains the QWindow until background session destruction

excluded: multi-layer timeline composition and VFR/source-rate conversion
DPI transition and multi-display manual evidence
